time.speed: Fixed 1 model second per wall-clock second in the running service
time.display: Asia/Almaty wall clock. Model automatically resumes at speed 1 after restart; production HTTP API rejects pause, speed and step.

endpoints.returns: Full snapshot: clock, areas, units, inventory, rework, finishedStock, totals, kpis, conservation, risks, incidents, events, history, configuration, planning, serverTime (UTC wall clock), persistence (lastSavedAt, savedRevision, errors)
Factor catalog with bounds/default/current/source/apply, caseData, scenarios, defaults, demos
SSE, event name state, data is full snapshot, every second. Closing browser does not pause server.
202 {id,status,url,basedOnRevision}; poll url for status completed/failed. Only one worker at a time: 429 if busy.
{status,result? ,error?}. result.results includes baseline and variants; metrics are increments over the forecast horizon; delta is paired against baseline by seed.
Rule-based recommendations, inventory coverage, losses and shift plan; basedOnRevision identifies snapshot.
Original PDF, id brief or data
Last 8 saved scenario jobs, newest first; results available via jobs/:id. Includes options/status/createdAt and archive error.
{message,previousId?} ->202 {id,url}. Generates and executes isolated scenario or returns a clarification.
Job with new frames starting from index, execution plan, result and answer
Aborts active provider request and worker; keeps partial results

commands.note: Absolute model elapsed seconds; must be in future and within one day
Replaces run with defaults plus supplied factor overrides; automatically runs in real time

commands.description: Records acknowledgment only; repair still follows model time.
Replaces live run, warms up fixed seed 4817 and continues in real time. IDs cascade, materials, quality.

rendering.progress: areas[].job.progress is 0..1; freeze machinery unless status=working
rendering.vehicle: units[] includes queued, processing, rework and finished vehicles; units may leave snapshot when shipped/scrapped
rendering.operationText: Use status/reason and event messages; 12-second visual loops are not production cycle duration

metrics.ratios: 0..1, null means denominator unavailable; format as percent only at UI
metrics.oee: Per area only. Availability = workingSeconds/plannedSeconds; performance = completed idealSeconds/workingSeconds; quality = firstPassGood/completed. Do not average area OEE into factoryOee (null).
metrics.initialWip: Excluded from average full lead time, included in mass balance
metrics.quality: Per-stage defect events differ from totals.defectiveUnits (unique affected vehicles). firstPassYield is first-pass finished divided by finished plus scrapped units.
metrics.cost: Illustrative energy + labor + rework + scrap only. Not full vehicle cost or profit.
metrics.history: Five-minute cumulative samples, at most 2016 records
metrics.unitBalance: initialWip + started = active + finishedStock + shipped + scrapped
metrics.forecastDowntime: Sum of incremental downtime minutes across all modeled posts, not wall-clock factory downtime.

persistence: Model checkpoint every 10 seconds and after commands, plus last 8 scenario jobs/results saved atomically to independent Allur Docker volume. Finished forecasts survive restart; interrupted jobs are marked failed with an explanation.

agent.provider: OpenAI Responses API, store:false; server-side Docker secret
agent.execution: Strict function tool translated to bounded factory commands; isolated copies, no shell or arbitrary JavaScript execution
agent.timeline: 101 calculated forecast snapshots, UI playback is independent of live server time
agent.comparison: Three seeds, baseline and scenario; charts show scenario medians minus baseline medians
agent.archive: Last 8 jobs including scenario, frames, result, explanation; atomic save to state.json.agent.json
agent.limits: One active request, six requests per minute, 4000 characters, horizon 1–16 h
agent.areaDetails: Workers and sensors come from the scenario configuration/state, never personal data or actual telemetry
